## Checklist before merge

- [ ] Branch name and pull request title include the task ID
- [ ] The change meets the task's acceptance criteria
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and all tests pass locally
- [ ] CI passes with no high or critical security findings
- [ ] No secrets, passwords, keys or `.env` files are included
- [ ] User input is validated and errors are handled (API changes)
- [ ] Documentation updated if behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] Reviewer requested (auth, token or RBAC changes: Anas Delowar as well)

## Definition of Done (completed after merge)

- [ ] Peer-reviewed and merged
- [ ] Acceptance criteria pass
- [ ] Automated tests pass in CI with no high or critical security findings
- [ ] Deployed to HTTPS staging and verified on mobile and desktop, with no critical accessibility issues
- [ ] Accepted by the Product Owner at the Sprint Review
